scenarios.prompt: Review a C++ diff using raw new/delete and manual mutex lock/unlock with early returns in between.
expected: flags the leak/deadlock risk on early-return paths
checks rule-of-zero/rule-of-five completeness on touched classes

scenarios.prompt: A function takes const std::shared_ptr<T>& just to read T, and a class stores a raw pointer to an object owned elsewhere.
expected: requires borrowing to be expressed as const T& / T* instead of shared_ptr
requires a lifetime contract (or weak_ptr) for the stored observer pointer
questions shared ownership when no second owner exists

scenarios.prompt: The agent templates a class over its only instantiated type 'for future flexibility'.
expected: rejects templating without a real second type
cites template cost (errors, compile time) versus benefit
does not apply C macro rules as primary standard
